title: Correction cues by conversation
description: Conversations ranked by correction-cue messages sent in the last 7 days; inspect their actual wording.

title: Error volume by tool
description: Recorded error calls started in the last 7 days, split by tool.

title: Recurring error signatures
description: Diagnostic signatures on at least two error calls started in the last 7 days, with conversation reach.

title: Recorded command time
description: Sum of positive recorded durations for calls started in the last 7 days, grouped by command name.

title: Failed edit paths
description: Error-marked edit calls started in the last 7 days, grouped by repository and mapped relative path.

title: Reported test failures
description: Calls with a recorded test-failure signal started in the last 7 days, grouped by repository and command.

title: Tool context exposure
description: Later token-exposures of tool results from calls started in the last 7 days; includes later requests.

title: Tool context additions
description: Attributed result tokens from calls started in the last 7 days, split by tool and attribution source.

title: Tool truncation rates
description: Truncated share of all calls started in the last 7 days, by tool; ten-call minimum.

title: Most-read repository paths
description: Read calls started in the last 7 days per repository path, with distinct recorded conversation counts.

title: Repeated search queries
description: Exact stored web queries used at least twice over the last 7 days, including repeated attempts.

title: Primary web sites
description: Web calls by primary recorded host over the last 7 days, ranked by call count.

title: Recorded MCP methods
description: Retained agent tool calls with MCP methods during the last 7 days, grouped by server and method.

title: Skills across conversations
description: Distinct recorded conversations with successful skill evidence over the last 7 days, ranked by skill name.

title: Failed skill calls
description: Distinct parent calls with error-marked skill evidence during the last 7 days, grouped by skill and provider.

title: Last seven days of writing
description: Human-written words sent during the last 7 days, grouped by the day they were sent.

title: Words written per repository
description: Human-written words over the last 7 days, grouped by repository.

title: Model use over time
description: Recorded tokens during the last 7 days, grouped by day and model; cached input is included.

title: Daily token volume
description: Recorded tokens by day and repository over the last 7 days; cached and unpriced usage included.

title: Daily API equivalent
description: Fully priced API equivalent by recorded day and repository over the last 7 days.

title: Cached input over time
description: Recorded cache-read tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by day and model.

title: Delegated tokens over time
description: Recorded delegated token volume over the last 7 days, attributed to each task’s root repository.

title: Tool failure rates
description: Error calls divided by all calls started in the last 7 days; tools with ten or more calls.

title: Command duration spread
description: Positive recorded call durations in the last 7 days, by command and timing source; three-call minimum.

title: Tool result sizes
description: Nonempty result sizes for calls started in the last 7 days; three-call minimum per tool/source group.

title: Do slower tools produce more output?
description: Average duration versus average output, by tool and token source.

title: Errors across repositories
description: Signatures shared by at least two named repositories over the last 7 days, ranked by repository reach.

title: Repository error hotspots
description: Repository/signature pairs ranked by recorded error calls started in the last 7 days; counts, not rates.

title: Skills across repositories
description: Named repositories with successful skill evidence over the last 7 days; skills recorded in at least two.

title: TL1 configuration advancement
description: Attempt advancement over the last 7 days within TL1 project, flavor, execution-class, and version cohorts; three-attempt minimum.

title: Recorded repricing comparison
description: Historical API equivalent versus retained current-price estimates over the last 7 days; current-price completeness is unverified.

title: Recently active lifetime costs
description: Lifetime API equivalent for fully priced recorded work active in the last 7 days; includes older usage.

title: Provider duration cohorts
description: Positive recorded durations in the last 7 days, grouped by provider and tool category; three-call minimum.

title: Rereads within conversations
description: Repository paths read at least twice in one recorded conversation during the last 7 days.

title: Authorship by repository
description: Human-written share of retained user-message text over the last 7 days, grouped by repository.

title: Largest token workloads
description: Root-task token totals including recorded delegated work over the last 7 days, ranked by period volume.

title: Cache reuse by model
description: Cache-read share of all input over the last 7 days, weighted by tokens; cache writes included.

title: Session cost by effort
description: Mean whole-conversation cost including delegation over the last 7 days, grouped by top-level model and effort.

title: Recorded harness versions
description: Distinct active agent sessions over the last 7 days, grouped by harness and first/last recorded version.

title: Delegated runs by depth
description: Active canonical delegated runs over the last 7 days, counted at their resolved ancestry depth.

title: Token pricing coverage
description: Recorded token shares by pricing status over the last 7 days; assumed and missing prices stay visible.

title: Calls issued together
description: Tool calls in multi-call model requests started in the last 7 days, grouped by tool.

title: Pharos MCP payloads
description: Individual Pharos response sizes over the last 7 days, grouped by tool; three-response minimum, including errors.

title: Messages reused across conversations
description: Exact messages appearing in at least three recorded conversations over the last 7 days.

title: How many messages am I writing per conversation?
description: A distribution of messages containing your words in this window; open conversation totals.

title: Positive feedback messages
description: Conversations ranked by praise or thanks messages sent in the last 7 days; inspect the wording.

title: Where do I report taking action?
description: Your messages matching phrases such as ‘I fixed’ or ‘I ran’, grouped by conversation.

title: Supplied examples and context
description: Human contributions containing images, pasted text, or file references during the last 7 days; categories overlap.

title: Recorded skill body volume
description: Sum of known positive skill-body bytes over the last 7 days, separated by skill and evidence type.

title: Repeated skill file loads
description: Conversation/path pairs with at least two successful skill file-load calls over the last 7 days.

title: Pharos zero-result searches
description: Successful Pharos search calls with explicitly recorded zero results over the last 7 days, by method.

title: Paths edited repeatedly
description: Mapped repository paths with at least two edit calls started in the last 7 days, including failed attempts.

title: Setup and access errors
description: Recorded package/build/container errors or missing-file/permission errors in the last 7 days, grouped by repository and error type.

title: Repeated failed commands
description: Exact commands with at least two error calls in one agent conversation over the last 7 days.

title: Which TL1 tasks are being revisited?
description: Attempts explicitly marked as revisits, grouped by project and task.

title: Mixed TL1 dispositions
description: Shared TL1 candidates with multiple configurations and recorded dispositions during the last 7 days; cohorts remain separate.

title: URLs across conversations
description: Exact primary web URLs recorded in at least two agent conversations over the last 7 days.

title: Which work needs the most of my writing?
description: Your words and messages in this window, grouped by canonical work identity.

title: When you work
description: Human-written words by local clock hour across all time; includes all dates combined.

title: Weekly writing volume over time
description: Human-written words over each trailing 7-day period, with 30 days of history for comparison.

title: Daily words per repository
description: Human-written words per day by repository over the last 7 days, averaged over each trailing 7 days.

title: Words per message
description: Average human-written words per message over each trailing 7-day period; excludes messages without human writing.

title: Words per conversation
description: Average human-written words per conversation over each trailing 7-day period, including conversations started earlier.

title: Words per workspace directory
description: Average human-written words per workspace directory over trailing 7 days, combining conversations sharing that directory.

title: Conversation words by repo
description: Average human-written words per conversation in the last 7 days, compared across repositories with sample counts.

title: Which conversations need more of my input?
description: Conversations ranked by messages you wrote, alongside words and average message length.

title: Conversation size profile
description: Conversations grouped by human-written word totals over the last 7 days; each bar shows a size band.

title: Human contribution patterns
description: Brief continuations, concrete feedback cues, supplied context, and other writing.

title: Feedback with concrete detail
description: Share of assessed human-written messages with concrete feedback cues over each trailing 7-day period.

title: Messages per day
description: Messages containing your words per day, averaged over each trailing seven complete days, across the last 30 days.

title: Conversations per day
description: Conversations in which you wrote per day, averaged over each trailing seven complete days, across the last 30 days.

title: Model token share over time
description: Model share of total recorded tokens over the last 7 days, smoothed over 7 days.

title: Model cost share over time
description: Model share of total API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days, smoothed over 7 days.

title: Conversation costs
description: Whole-conversation costs including delegation over the last 7 days; models with five or more conversations.

title: Deepest subagent tree
description: Largest resolved delegation depth active in the last 7 days; top-level conversation is level zero.

title: Largest subagent tree
description: Most distinct delegated runs active in one conversation over the last 7 days, including nested agents.

title: Human input and output
description: Estimated human-supplied text tokens versus recorded output per whole conversation over the last 7 days; log–log axes.

title: Delegated runs per conversation
description: Delegated runs among delegating conversations over the last 7 days; model/effort cohorts with three or more observations.

title: Session roles by model
description: Active agent session shares by model over the last 7 days: singleton roots, parent roots, and subagents.

title: Cost by effort
description: API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days, split by effort; fully priced usage, including unspecified effort.

title: Model tokens and cost
description: Recorded tokens versus API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days; one point per fully priced provider/model pair.

title: Session tokens and cost
description: Whole-conversation tokens versus priced cost over the last 7 days, including delegated work; log–log axes.

title: Session input and output
description: Whole-conversation input versus output over the last 7 days, including delegated work; log–log axes.

title: Model token share
description: Recorded tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by provider and model.

title: Model conversation share
description: Share of model/conversation pairings over the last 7 days; multi-model conversations count under each model.

title: Models by repository
description: Recorded tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by repository and model.

title: Model session size
description: Agent sessions versus tokens per session over the last 7 days, one point per model/provider pair.

title: Model cost share
description: API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days, split by model and provider; fully priced usage only.

title: Cost per million tokens
description: API-equivalent cost per million recorded tokens over the last 7 days, using only fully priced usage.

title: Cache reuse and cost
description: Cached input share versus API-equivalent cost per million tokens over the last 7 days; fully priced usage.

title: Cache reuse by repository
description: Cache-read share of all input over the last 7 days, weighted by tokens; cache writes included.

title: Input volume and reuse
description: Whole-conversation input versus cache-read share over the last 7 days, including delegated work; logarithmic input axis.

title: Tool result reuse
description: Token-weighted later requests per result from calls started in the last 7 days, including never-carried results.

title: Repository failure rates
description: Error calls divided by all calls started in the last 7 days; repositories with ten or more calls.

title: Failures per conversation
description: Error calls per affected agent conversation over the last 7 days; tools with three or more affected conversations.

title: Tool call mix
description: Recorded calls started in the last 7 days, split by tool.

title: Calls per conversation
description: Tool calls per recorded agent conversation over the last 7 days; repositories with three or more conversations.

title: Timing coverage by tool
description: Share of calls with nonnegative recorded durations in the last 7 days; tools with ten or more calls.

title: Longest recorded call
description: Maximum recorded duration among calls started in the last 7 days; inspect each tool’s longest call.

title: Pharos MCP calling clients
description: Recorded agent requests to Pharos in the last 7 days, grouped by caller source and provider.

title: Pharos MCP queried sources
description: Pharos requests by explicit archive source filter in the last 7 days; unspecified filters remain visible.

title: Pharos MCP tool durations
description: Positive Pharos server durations in the last 7 days, grouped by tool; zero-millisecond entries excluded.

title: Skill evidence mix
description: Recorded skill evidence over the last 7 days, split into invocations, file-load attempts, and harness loads.

title: Skill body sizes
description: Positive retained skill-body sizes over the last 7 days, separated by skill and evidence type; three-record minimum.

title: Skill body size coverage
description: Share of successful skill evidence with recorded body sizes over the last 7 days, by evidence type.

title: Skill loads per conversation
description: Distinct successful file loads per conversation and skill path over the last 7 days; three-sample minimum.

title: Most skill file loads
description: Largest successful file-load count for one conversation and skill path over the last 7 days.

title: Searches by repository
description: Recorded web-search calls over the last 7 days, grouped by repository.

title: Searches per conversation
description: Web-search calls per searching agent conversation over the last 7 days; three conversations per repository required.

title: Queries across conversations
description: Exact stored web queries appearing in at least two agent conversations over the last 7 days.

title: Pharos empty-search rates
description: Zero-result share of successful Pharos searches with recorded counts over the last 7 days; ten-call minimum.

title: Provider cost share
description: Provider share of total API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days, smoothed over 7 days.

title: API equivalent this period
description: Total recorded API equivalent over the last 7 days, using fully priced positive-token usage facts only.

title: Repository cost share
description: Fully priced API equivalent over the last 7 days, attributed to each usage fact’s recorded repository.

title: Work costs in period
description: Root-task API equivalent including delegated work over the last 7 days, ranked by period cost.

title: Work cost ranges
description: Root-task period costs including delegated work over the last 7 days; three tasks per repository required.

title: Work volume and cost
description: Root-task counts versus period cost including delegation over the last 7 days, attributed to root repositories.

title: Tokens by channel
description: Recorded tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by channel.

title: API cost by channel
description: Recorded API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days, grouped by channel.

title: Tokens by machine
description: Recorded tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by machine.

title: API cost by machine
description: Recorded API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days, grouped by machine.

title: Tokens by execution machine
description: Recorded tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by execution machine.

title: API cost by execution machine
description: Recorded API-equivalent cost over the last 7 days, grouped by execution machine.

title: Run tokens by effort
description: Own tokens per standalone, parent, or delegated run by recorded effort over the last 7 days.

title: Repository token share
description: Recorded tokens over the last 7 days, attributed to each usage fact’s repository; includes cached input.

title: Task token ranges
description: Period tokens per root task including delegation over the last 7 days; three tasks per repository required.

title: Task output ranges
description: Recorded output per root task including delegation over the last 7 days; zero-output tasks remain included.

title: Output share by repository
description: Output tokens divided by all recorded tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by repository.

title: Task tokens by effort
description: Root-task tokens including delegation over the last 7 days, grouped by top-level effort; three-task minimum.

title: Task tokens by model
description: Root-task tokens including delegation over the last 7 days, grouped by top-level provider and model family.

title: Task tokens by model–effort
description: Root-task tokens including delegation over the last 7 days, grouped by top-level model family and effort.

title: Typical and largest tasks
description: Median versus maximum root-task tokens over the last 7 days, grouped by top-level provider and model family.

title: Task volume and delegation
description: Root-task tokens versus active delegated-run count over the last 7 days; log–log axes.

title: Task volume and delegated share
description: Root-task tokens versus their delegated token share over the last 7 days; zero-delegation tasks remain visible.

title: Repository input and output
description: Input versus output tokens by repository over the last 7 days; logarithmic axes include reused input.

title: Token timing evidence
description: Recorded token shares by request or session-based time placement over the last 7 days; unknown labels retained.

title: Delegated token share
description: Delegated tokens divided by all resolved task tokens over the last 7 days, by root repository.

title: Tasks using delegation
description: Share of active root tasks with active delegated runs over the last 7 days, by repository.

title: Delegated run sizes
description: Own tokens per active delegated run over the last 7 days, grouped by root repository.

title: Delegates per delegating task
description: Active delegated runs per delegating root task over the last 7 days, grouped by repository.

title: Tree depth and size
description: Deepest active delegate versus active descendant count per delegating task over the last 7 days.

title: Conversations with correction cues
description: Share of eligible conversations containing correction phrases over the last 7 days, grouped by repository.

title: Conversations with positive feedback
description: Share of eligible conversations containing praise or thanks over the last 7 days, grouped by repository.

title: Messages repeated within conversations
description: Exact message text sent repeatedly within one recorded conversation over the last 7 days.

title: Recorded machine time
description: Tool and command time over the last 7 days, by the kind of work.

title: Where machine time goes
description: Share of recorded tool time by kind of work over the last 7 days.

title: Longest-running operations
description: Commands and tools with the most recorded time over the last 7 days.

title: Tool calls per day
description: Daily tool calls averaged over each trailing seven complete days, across the last 30 days.

title: Average tool call time
description: Mean recorded duration per tool call over each trailing seven complete days, across the last 30 days.

title: Parallel hours by day
description: Hours with one, two, three, or four or more agents active, for each day of the last 7 days.

title: Agents at once
description: Average number of agents running together while any is active, over each trailing seven days.

title: When agents overlap
description: Agent hours at each hour of the day over the last 7 days, counting parallel agents separately.

title: Agent hours by repository
description: Active agent hours per repository over the last 7 days, counting parallel agents separately.

title: Estimated CO₂e
description: Modeled emissions from recorded tokens over each trailing 7-day period, across the last 30 days.

title: CO₂e by model size
description: Share of estimated emissions from small, mid-size and large models over the last 7 days.

title: CO₂e by repository
description: Repositories with the largest estimated emissions from recorded tokens over the last 7 days.

title: CO₂e by model
description: Models with the largest estimated emissions from recorded tokens over the last 7 days.

title: CO₂e by provider
description: Share of estimated emissions by agent provider over the last 7 days.

title: CO₂e by effort
description: Share of estimated emissions by recorded reasoning effort over the last 7 days.

title: Biggest open findings
description: Optimization findings with the largest likely monthly saving, from the latest Findings analysis.

title: Savings by kind of fix
description: Likely monthly savings across open findings, by where the suggested change is made.

title: Net savings from findings
description: What copied finding prompts have saved after their added context cost, across verified results.

title: Models needing prices
description: Models whose tokens are unpriced or priced by assumption, by all-time recorded token volume.

title: Smoothed token volume
description: Daily tokens by provider over the last 7 days, averaged over seven calendar days including idle days.

title: Token volume across scales
description: Daily repository tokens over the last 7 days on a logarithmic scale, keeping smaller workloads visible.

title: Accumulating API equivalent
description: API-equivalent cost accumulated from the start of the last 7 days, split by provider; fully priced facts only.

title: Pharos request activity
description: Daily requests served by Pharos over the last 7 days, split by tool and averaged over seven days.

title: Words by day of the week
description: Daily human-written word totals by weekday over the last 7 days, including idle days.

title: Messages by day of the week
description: Daily counts of messages containing your words by weekday over the last 7 days, including idle days.

title: Active hours by day of the week
description: Daily hours with any agent active by weekday over the last 7 days, including idle days.

title: Parallelism by day of the week
description: Daily time-weighted agents at once while active by weekday over the last 7 days; active days only.
